checks.explanation: Big Tech market caps peaked and then fell sharply within about a year: the ten largest tech stocks lost a combined $4.6 trillion in market cap in 2022 alone, with Meta down 77%, Amazon down 45%, and Alphabet down 39% from their highs, closely matching the 'peak within a year or two' prediction.

sources.title: Ten Big Tech Stocks Lost $4.6T Market Cap in 2022

checks.explanation: No clean winner emerged. Meta actually led on VR market share (about 74.6% of headsets in 2024) with cheaper, more mainstream devices, while Apple entered later (2024) at a much higher price point ($3,499 Vision Pro) pursuing a different 'spatial computing' strategy focused on AR rather than directly competing on VR headset volume. Apple's AR approach may be better positioned for long-term category growth, but Meta was not 'beaten handily' in the VR/AR race as predicted.

sources.title: Meta's VR vs. Apple's AR: Which Will Dominate the Metaverse?
